images.name: Kígyó
images.scene:
NEW ENCOUNTER: one green-and-gold snake, a wrist-thick body curled into a clear loose coil, with a small angular raised head facing the explorer. A few broad color markings, no intricate scales, no cobra hood, no extra snakes. Its coil is about one third of explorer height, easy to see without making it a giant creature. Explorer has stopped cautiously, empty hands open, seen from behind/three-quarter at lower-left of the central scene.
DISTINCT ENVIRONMENT: a narrow shaded hillside trail through a fern-lined rock gully. Low slate-gray ledges flank the path, a handful of broad simplified fern fronds and hanging vines arch above the snake, damp ochre soil with a few flat leaf shapes and one small puddle. Closed forest depth behind. A low mossy ledge behind the snake provides a contrasting backdrop. No large buttress-root trees, bamboo or open waterbank. Foliage has a different sparse fern silhouette from the jaguar grove; use a cool teal canopy with a small sun patch on the encounter.

images.name: Vaddisznó
images.scene:
NEW ENCOUNTER: one sturdy wild boar bursts from shrubs toward the explorer. A chunky dark reddish-brown body, wedge snout, two small ivory tusks, four short sturdy visible legs, pointed ears and a single little tail. Clear boar anatomy, no long fur strands, not a piglet or bear. Explorer braces with knees bent, empty hands held ready, facing it three-quarter from behind at lower-left of the central scene. Capture the charge without dust clouds or elaborate motion effects.
DISTINCT ENVIRONMENT: a sunlit red-ochre clay trail widening into a low scrub clearing on a gentle jungle slope. Broad heart-shaped leaves, a few thick low shrubs, dry yellow-green reed/grass clusters and one weathered stump with a fallen branch. Two rounded/faceted ochre-gray stones provide terrain variation; taller foliage stays at the outer edges. Warm golden sunlight, open central ground, distant layered green tree crowns. No waterfall, stream, mangrove roots, bamboo, fern-gully or tall buttress-tree corridor. Use sparse large plant silhouettes and clean few-tone ground shapes.

Match this image's moderately elevated three-quarter isometric game view EXACTLY. Notice the visible side planes of the explorer, upright tree trunks and animal: look diagonally down and into the scene at the SAME elevation as this jaguar picture. DO NOT make a steep overhead/bird's-eye view. Do not lower it to eye level either. Copy the jaguar's camera geometry, not its animal or jungle environment.

Preserve its distinct warm red-ochre jungle clearing, broad green scrub, sparse dry yellow-green grass clumps, few large faceted gray stones, broken stump and fallen branch. Re-render these from the jaguar's camera angle instead of steeply overhead. Allow upright trees and layered foliage in the upper background to give depth as in the jaguar reference; no sky or distant horizon. Exactly one explorer, matching its angular brown hair, dark short full beard, cream collared rolled-sleeve shirt, green cargo trousers, chunky brown boots, single diagonal brown satchel strap and small brown satchel. No redesigned character, crossed harness or extra backpack.

Boar should be naturally sized, about waist-high to the explorer, not a gigantic monster. One braced explorer at lower-left of the middle action area facing the boar at middle-right, rear three-quarter pose. Both full bodies visible, side surfaces and height readable as in jaguar reference. Match the jaguar reference's character scale relative to the full frame. Leave similar upper background and lower foreground breathing room for the game UI.
Style: match reference 1's deliberately simple camp-style low-poly illustration, large smooth matte color planes, clean silhouettes, few-tone shading, broad simplified leaves and rocks. No photorealism, intricate bark/fur, tiny leaf clutter or dense ground texture. Red-ochre clearing distinguishes this location.

No jaguar, other animals, extra people, camp furniture, waterfall, text, HUD, cards, logo, border or watermark.

images.name: Krokodil
images.scene:
NEW ENCOUNTER: one olive-green crocodile crawls partly out of shallow turquoise water toward the dry bank where the explorer has halted. Render a long broad wedge-shaped snout, distinct low body, four clear short feet and one tapering tail curving into the frame. A few large dorsal plates, no many tiny scales. Whole animal visible and naturally proportioned, roughly comparable overall length to explorer height. Explorer cautiously steps backward on dry sand, empty hands open, seen rear three-quarter.
DISTINCT ENVIRONMENT: a winding shallow mangrove channel crosses the clearing diagonally, pale sandy bank at left, clear blue-green shallows at right. A few large arching mangrove stilt roots emerge from the water, sparse rounded mangrove leaf crowns, one partly submerged gray rock, simple reed clusters and broad flat reflections. No waterfall or horizon. This scene's readable water-and-root shapes must be clearly different from inland forest trails. Keep a broad uncluttered dry encounter area in the middle-lower left, water in the middle-right, natural small animal-scale ripples only, soft dappled daylight.

images.name: Darazsak
images.scene:
NEW ENCOUNTER: a hanging pale gray-brown papery hornet nest attached to ONE low woody side branch across the trail, and FOUR unmistakable hornets hovering near its entrance. Important insect anatomy: each hornet has a separate small dark head with two antennae, a compact dark thorax, a very narrow pinched waist, an elongated yellow-and-black banded abdomen with a tapered tip, paired thin translucent wings, and slim bent legs. Simple clean game-art shapes, but anatomically clearly WASPS/HORNETS: not round bees, butterflies, birds, orange blobs or winged balls. Approximately hand-sized at game illustration scale, clustered near nest rather than covering the whole canvas. Nest is an oval layered-paper shell with 4–5 broad bands and one dark lower entrance, NO exposed honeycomb. Explorer ducks slightly and raises a forearm protectively while looking toward the nest, rear three-quarter, empty hands, no torch yet (the action is still undecided).
DISTINCT ENVIRONMENT: a bright narrow bamboo corridor with tall simple jointed yellow-green stems in uneven groups on both sides, long clean blade-leaf fans, a low woody tree branch carrying the nest from the right, a few broad pale stones and light honey-colored soil. Sparse broad foliage, green filtered sunlight and a shallow leafy slope behind; no creek, waterfall, massive buttress roots or camp equipment. Nest at middle-right near character-head height so insect silhouettes and explorer can be seen simultaneously in the central gameplay area. Keep foliage broad and uncluttered around the insects for clear recognition.

images.name: Majmok
images.scene:
NEW ENCOUNTER: exactly TWO small brown long-tailed monkeys attempt to steal the explorer's single brown satchel. One monkey on the ground near center-right grips the loose satchel strap with its hands while the explorer holds the bag close with one arm and reaches to recover the strap. A second monkey crouches on a low fallen tree trunk just behind, watching for an opening. Each monkey has a clear rounded angular head, lighter tan face/muzzle, distinct hands/feet and one long curved tail; stylized few-plane anatomy, no fur texture, not apes or cats. There is only ONE bag; explorer does not wear an extra backpack. Keep the brown diagonal shoulder strap and satchel consistent with character sheet; the theft is ongoing, not resolved.
DISTINCT ENVIRONMENT: a small tropical fruit-tree grove on the edge of a woodland terrace. Chunky low spreading trunks with rounded broad green crowns and just a few large muted yellow-orange fruits in upper clusters; a large fallen log with simple flat cut ends crosses middle-right. Low broad split leaves and two flat mossy stones frame the ochre path, with cool soft jungle depth behind. Dappled warm afternoon light. No watercourse, bamboo, fern-rock gully, large buttress-root corridor, camp furniture or copied jaguar background. The fruit grove, horizontal log and two monkeys define a distinct readable composition.
